trigger: changelog.d/4981-preview-scope-atoms.security.md described the ladder-reuse fix and confinement-ordering change but omitted two real behavior changes this PR shipped: the new 403 service-token deny and the TTL-touch suppression
classification_rationale: a shipped, security-relevant behavior change had no corresponding changelog sentence
summary: Appended a sentence covering the 403 service-token deny and TTL-touch suppression to the existing fragment. Confirmed by architect NICE-2 as still-open at one intermediate commit; closed in fix round 3db3c6cf6.

trigger: scope_preview.hpp's doc comment claimed a null result_set_store also aborts Unresolvable on props.<key> atoms; the diff's own test (result_set_store=nullptr + a live props-store closure -> kOk) proves this false
classification_rationale: an in-code comment contradicted the actual, tested behavior of a fail-closed security contract this PR exists to make trustworthy
summary: Rewrote the comment: null result_set_store only affects from_result_set: atoms; props.<key> fail-closed behavior is controlled independently by whatever CustomPropertiesStore the caller's evaluate_scope_fn closure binds. Fixed in 3db3c6cf6, re-verified by cpp-expert at Gate 8.

trigger: MCP preview_scope_targets's owner_check_failed arm called the bare 3-arg error_response(), emitting no data object at all -- no correlation_id, no retry_after_ms, unlike its sibling db_degraded/principal_unresolved arm 20 lines below which uses the shared a4_error lambda
classification_rationale: the A4 envelope fields agentic-first-principle.md's A5 requires on every failure response were absent on this one response class
summary: Routed the owner_check_failed arm through the same a4_error lambda its sibling arm already uses, adding correlation_id and retry_after_ms:null. Fixed in 3db3c6cf6; empirically re-verified at Gate 8 (ran the exact test, confirmed both fields present).

trigger: REST and MCP both computed permanent-vs-transient via a raw string match on ScopePreviewOutcome::detail rather than an exhaustive switch on the typed ScopeEvalError::Kind -- a future 6th Kind value would silently land in the transient bucket with no compile-time warning
classification_rationale: a required exhaustiveness guard against a closed 5-value enum was absent, duplicated as a raw string match at two call sites instead of one typed classifier
summary: Added scope_abort_is_permanent(ScopeEvalError::Kind) in scope_eval_error.hpp (exhaustive switch, no default:, -Werror=switch-enforced) and a typed abort_kind field on ScopePreviewOutcome; both REST and MCP now call the shared classifier. Fixed in 3db3c6cf6; re-verified by security-guardian at Gate 8 including the -Werror=switch wiring and the mapping's semantic correctness.

trigger: deny_fleet_wide_service_scoped (the shared ~9-route REST chokepoint) incremented no metric, while MCP's C8 structural deny for the identical tool DOES increment yuzu_auth_service_scope_default_denied_total -- a REST/MCP observability asymmetry for the same denial class
classification_rationale: an aggregate-rate metric this repo already emits for the equivalent MCP denial was absent on the REST path
summary: Extended deny_fleet_wide_service_scoped to increment yuzu_auth_service_scope_default_denied_total{path_class="rest"}, falling back to permission="unspecified" for a blanket deny. Fixed in 3db3c6cf6; empirically re-verified at Gate 8 (metric name/label identity, deny-path-only placement, bounded cardinality across all ~27 call sites, real-registry test wiring all confirmed).

trigger: docs/observability-conventions.md's yuzu_auth_service_scope_default_denied_total paragraph named only 2 of the metric's now-3 increment sites after the sre-deny-helper-unmetered-rest fix landed a 3rd (path_class="rest", a fixed literal vs. the other sites' per-route derivation)

trigger: the changelog fragment's parenthetical named last_used_at as the suppressed TTL field; touch() actually keeps alive ttl_at (the GC-reaper's expiry field), and last_used_at is a separate pagination sort key -- confirmed against result_set_store.cpp and scope-walking-design.md's own canonical TTL/GC table
classification_rationale: the changelog cited the wrong field name for an otherwise-accurate claim
summary: Corrected the parenthetical to name ttl_at as the suppressed field and last_used_at as the separate pagination sort key. Fixed in ee24abadd.

trigger: resolve_scope_aliases/scope_refs_failing_owner_check (scope_yaml.cpp) have no dedup and no cap on from_result_set: occurrence count -- a repeated-token expression near the 4MiB body cap could theoretically trigger up to ~400,000 sequential synchronous Postgres round trips on one httplib worker thread
classification_rationale: no occurrence cap or dedup exists on the shared scope-ladder ref-resolution loop
summary: Gate 5 chaos-injector empirically measured the real, reachable ceiling through preview_scope_targets/scope-preview specifically: yuzu::scope::validate()'s pre-existing 4096-char expression-length gate caps occurrence count at ~195, bounding real cost to ~26ms/request (~1000x below the theoretical danger zone) -- confirmed the underlying O(refs) mechanism is real (linear ~70us/round-trip, verified to 10,000 refs bypassing the gate directly) but not reachable at dangerous scale through this entry point. Mechanism is pre-existing (shared with real dispatch, not introduced by this PR) and already tracked as issue #2635 UP-8 from an earlier PR's governance round; not fixed in this PR -- corroborating comment with these empirical numbers added to #2635 instead of filing a duplicate.
